notes: ING España "Descargar movimientos" gives Excel only (sheet "Movimientos"); importers handle it as .xls or .xlsx (KashaFlow calls it the "ING España XLS"), written here as .xlsx. Rows 1-3: "Movimientos de la Cuenta" and, in columns C-D, "  Número de cuenta:" / "  Titular:" / "  Fecha exportación:" with their values (leading spaces kept). Header row 4: F. VALOR | CATEGORÍA | SUBCATEGORÍA | DESCRIPCIÓN | COMENTARIO | IMPORTE (€) | SALDO (€) (the 2026 form; files from 2024 had an extra IMAGEN column before IMPORTE). Dates are Excel date serials, amounts signed numbers, SALDO the running balance, newest first.
